name: My Russian Trip
source:
Hideo Wakatabi, an ordinary Japanese student, decides to travel to Russia to study and find information for his graduation work. The path of our hero starts in the pearl of Primorye (seaside Russian area) - Vladivostok city. Here Hideo begins to get acquainted with the many-sided northern country and its inhabitants (females in particular). Three charming girls with different dreams will help Hideo collect the materials for the diploma work, but none of them can imagine that the greatest adventure of their lives is already waiting for them...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/885170/]Steam[/url]]
